text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-A five-nation committee monitoring an April ceasefire understanding between Lebanon and Israel will meet tomorrow.
-Lebanese army troop buildup in the western sector of the Bekaa valley.
-Continuous fears of an Israeli operation. Tel Aviv warns Damascus.
-Israeli air raids and artillery shelling of south Lebanon.
-One Israeli soldier was wounded when his group tried unsuccessfully to infiltrate into Lebanese-held areas outside the zone.
-Head of the union of journalists demands a new media law and calls the union of Arab journalists to an emergency meeting.
-Israeli Defense Minister threatens a military operation.
-Syrian Information Minister Mohammed Salman: The redeployment of Syrian troops in Lebanon are linked to the increasing Israeli threats which we all heard in the recent period.
